pageItems.comments: T359 independent re-derivation of T352's central claim. 300.6255545 carries a NON-ZERO digit at the THIRD decimal, so a 2-minor-digit currency would refuse it if the oracle enforced the minor unit. It is also SEVEN decimals against numeric(19,6), and the residue is EXACTLY half after an EVEN kept digit: HALF_EVEN and truncation both give 300.625554, HALF_UP gives 300.625555. Value chosen independently of T352's 100.1234565.
